title: Monsoon Mein Slab Dhalai Ki Mistake: Kaise Bachayein?

chapters.name: Monsoon Ki Sabse Badi Galti
chapters.vo: Agar aap monsoon ke mausam mein apne ghar ki slab dhalai karwa rahe hain, toh ek choti si laparwahi aapke poore RCC structure ko kamzor kar sakti hai. Contractor ho ya ghar malik, aaj hum baat karenge un zaroori savdhaniyon ki jo barish ke dino mein dhalai, curing, aur shuttering ke waqt rakhni padti hain. Video ko dhyaan se dekhiye, kyunki ant mein hum aapko ek aisi cheez batayenge jo aapka har dhalai ka kharcha aur pareshani dono kam kar degi. Toh shuru karte hain pehle aur sabse bade sawal se ki barish mein dhalai karte waqt sabse bada khatra kya hota hai.

chapters.name: Slab Dhalai aur Barish Ka Samay
chapters.vo: Sukur hai ki weather forecast ab mobile par mil jata hai, lekin site par dhalai ke dauran achanak barish aa jaye toh kya karein? Pehli baat, agar dhalai chal rahi hai aur tez barish shuru ho gayi, toh fresh concrete mein upar se paani milne dena sabse bada paap hai. Isse cement ka slurry bahar aa jata hai aur concrete ki strength khatam ho jati hai. Hamesha site par tarpaulins yani tripal tayar rakhein. Agar dhalai poori hone wali hai, toh use turant dhak dein. Aur haan, agar slab dhal chuki hai aur dhalne ke turant baad barish ho gayi, toh ghabrayein mat, kyunki curing ke liye paani toh chahiye hi, lekin itna nahi ki concrete wash out ho jaye. Isliye apne site engineer se hamesha consult karke hi timing fix karein.

chapters.name: Curing aur Paani Ki Quality
chapters.vo: Ab baat karte hain curing yaani tarai ki. Monsoon mein aksar log sochte hain ki mausam mein nami hai, toh tarai ki kya zaroorat hai? Yeh bilkul galat soch hai. Concrete ko apni strength pakadne ke liye hydration process ke liye proper paani chahiye hota hai, chahe barish ho ya dhoop. Aur sabse zaroori baat, curing ke liye jo paani aap use kar rahe hain, woh clean hona chahiye. Kai baar log barish ka jama hua ganda paani ya mitti wala paani use kar lete hain, jismein chemicals ya impurities hoti hain jo sariya yaani reinforcement ko andar se rust kar deti hain. Hamesha fresh water hi use karein aur kam se kam das se choda din curing zaroor chalne dein, chahe bahar kitni bhi nami ho.

chapters.name: Shuttering aur Formwork Ki Savdhan
chapters.vo: Monsoon mein sabse zyada dikkat aati hai shuttering yani centering ke material mein. Agar aap purani ya low quality ki wooden ply use kar rahe hain, toh barish ka paani absorb karke woh phool jati hai, tedhi ho jati hai aur slab ka level bigad jata hai. Isse concrete ki surface bhi kharab hoti hai aur finishing ke waqt plaster mein extra kharcha aata hai. Shuttering karte waqt dhyan dein ki plate ya sheet waterproof ho, taaki barish ya concrete ke wet mix se usme koi swelling na aaye. Joints ko achhi tarah se seal karein taaki cement slurry niche na tapke. Aur support yaani props mazboot lagayein kyunki geeli mitti par props baithne ka dar hamesha rehta hai.

chapters.name: VAJRA Aur Samapan
chapters.vo: Toh in sabhi pareshaniyon se bachne ke liye aajkal Chhattisgarh aur poore India mein contractors ek behtar alternative use kar rahe hain—aur woh hai PP hollow shuttering sheet, jaise ki VAJRA Formwork ki sheets. Yeh waterproof hoti hain, bilkul nahi phoolti hain, aur inme nails bhi achhi tarah pakad banate hain. Sabse acchi baat yeh hai ki ek aadmi inhe aaram se utha sakta hai, light-grey color ki hoti hain, aur sahi handling ke saath yeh ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hain, jisse har dhalai ka kharcha kam ho jata hai.
